### RULE-CAT-045 — Import row validation
Scope      : ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-009
Trigger    : on import row
Statement  : The system shall validate each data row against RULE-CAT-001, RULE-CAT-002, RULE-CAT-003, RULE-CAT-006, RULE-CAT-026, RULE-CAT-029, RULE-CAT-030 and RULE-CAT-042, skip every row that fails, and report its row number, column and reason. A category code that matches no active Category is a failure of column category with the RULE-CAT-026 message.
Message    : ar: الصف {row}، العمود {column}: {reason}. صحّح الصف وأعد استيراده. · en: Row {row}, column {column}: {reason}. Correct the row and import it again.
Traces     : REQ-CAT-037, REQ-CAT-041
Data source: ENT-CAT-001.nameAr, ENT-CAT-001.nameEn, ENT-CAT-001.baseUomCode, ENT-CAT-001.categoryFk, ENT-CAT-001.brandCode, ENT-CAT-001.taxClassCode, ENT-CAT-001.einvoiceCodeTypeCode, ENT-CAT-001.einvoiceCode, ENT-CAT-009.barcodeValue
Source     : US-CAT-010; KB:raw-idea.md §6.5

### RULE-CAT-046 — Search term minimum
Scope      : ENT-CAT-001
Trigger    : on catalogue search
Statement  : The system shall require a search term of at least 2 characters before searching.
Message    : ar: اكتب حرفين على الأقل للبحث. · en: Type at least 2 characters to search.

### RULE-CAT-047 — Barcode not found
Scope      : ENT-CAT-009
Trigger    : on barcode lookup
Statement  : The system shall return no Variant, with a next action, when no active barcode and no active scale label layout matches the value.
Message    : ar: لا يوجد صنف بهذا الباركود. ابحث بالاسم أو أضف الباركود إلى الصنف. · en: No item has this barcode. Search by name or add the barcode to the item.
Traces     : REQ-CAT-090

### RULE-CAT-048 — Deactivation keeps records for consumers (ARCH-5)
Scope      : ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-002, ENT-CAT-006, ENT-CAT-007, ENT-CAT-008, ENT-CAT-009
Trigger    : on deactivation
Statement  : The system shall deactivate a SHARED (owner) record by setting isActiveFl to false, never by deletion, keep it readable by identifier for consuming modules, exclude it from new selections and publish a catalogue-change event with change kind DEACTIVATED.
Message    : ar: تم الإيقاف. يبقى السجل متاحًا للمستندات السابقة ولا يظهر في الاختيارات الجديدة. · en: Deactivated. The record stays available to earlier documents and no longer appears in new selections.
Traces     : REQ-CAT-005, REQ-CAT-050, REQ-CAT-066, REQ-CAT-079, REQ-CAT-085
Data source: ENT-CAT-001.isActiveFl, ENT-CAT-002.isActiveFl, ENT-CAT-006.isActiveFl, ENT-CAT-007.isActiveFl, ENT-CAT-008.isActiveFl, ENT-CAT-009.isActiveFl
Source     : ARCH-5 (effect on SOFT-READ consumers: notify, never cascade)

### RULE-CAT-049 — Change events only after commit
Scope      : ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-002, ENT-CAT-005, ENT-CAT-007, ENT-CAT-008, ENT-CAT-009, ENT-CAT-010
Trigger    : on commit or rollback of a catalogue change
Statement  : The system shall record each catalogue-change event in the same transaction as the change and deliver it only after commit.
Message    : ar: تعذّر حفظ التغيير ولم يُرسل أي إشعار بالتغيير. أعد المحاولة. · en: The change was not saved and no change notice was sent. Try again.
Traces     : REQ-CAT-008, REQ-CAT-009
Data source: ENT-CAT-001.itemPk, ENT-CAT-002.variantPk
Source     : US-CAT-002; given `events` outbox

## A6 — Lookups

```yaml name=lookups
lookups:
  - {key: CAT_ITEM_KIND, seeded: [STANDARD, BUNDLE], open: false, values: [STANDARD, BUNDLE], fields: [itemKindCode], owner: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-001, control: lookup, source: "US-CAT-012; D-04"}
  - {key: CAT_PUBLISH_STATE, seeded: [UNPUBLISHED, PUBLISHED], open: false, values: [UNPUBLISHED, PUBLISHED], fields: [publishStateCode], owner: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-001, control: lookup, source: "POL-CAT-008; US-CAT-020"}
  - {key: CAT_BRAND, seeded: [], open: true, values: [], fields: [brandCode], owner: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-001, control: lookup, source: "US-CAT-014; module-registry LOOKUPS OWNED (brand); DP §8 P-05"}
  - {key: CAT_UOM, seeded: [PIECE, CARTON, BOX, DOZEN, KILOGRAM, GRAM, METRE, LITRE], open: true, values: [PIECE, CARTON, BOX, DOZEN, KILOGRAM, GRAM, METRE, LITRE, BAG], fields: [baseUomCode, uomCode, key], owner: CAT, entity: "ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-008, ENT-CAT-009, ENT-CAT-012", control: lookup, source: "US-CAT-014, US-CAT-015; module-registry LOOKUPS OWNED (unit-of-measure); D-12"}
  - {key: CAT_TAX_CLASS, seeded: [STANDARD, ZERO_RATED, EXEMPT], open: true, values: [STANDARD, ZERO_RATED, EXEMPT], fields: [taxClassCode], owner: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-001, control: lookup, source: "US-CAT-021; ADR-CAT-040"}
  - {key: CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE, seeded: [GS1, EGS], open: false, values: [GS1, EGS], fields: [einvoiceCodeTypeCode], owner: CAT, entity: "ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-002", control: lookup, source: "PRD P-4; Egypt ETA e-invoice SDK itemType"}
  - {key: CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT, seeded: [EA, KGM, GRM, MTR, LTR, CT, BX, DZN], open: true, values: [EA, KGM, GRM, MTR, LTR, CT, BX, DZN, H87], fields: [einvoiceUnitCode], owner: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-012, control: lookup, source: "US-CAT-021; Egypt ETA e-invoice SDK unitType; D-12"}
  - {key: CAT_BARCODE_TYPE, seeded: [GTIN, INTERNAL, SCALE], open: false, values: [GTIN, INTERNAL, SCALE], fields: [barcodeTypeCode], owner: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-009, control: lookup, source: "module-registry OI-10; D-05"}
  - {key: CAT_SCALE_VALUE_TYPE, seeded: [WEIGHT, PRICE], open: false, values: [WEIGHT, PRICE], fields: [embeddedValueTypeCode], owner: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-011, control: lookup, source: "US-CAT-017; module-registry OI-10"}
  - {key: CAT_CHANGE_KIND, seeded: [CREATED, UPDATED, DEACTIVATED, REACTIVATED], open: false, values: [CREATED, UPDATED, DEACTIVATED, REACTIVATED], fields: [], owner: CAT, entity: "catalogue-change event (REQ-CAT-008)", control: event payload, source: "US-CAT-002"}
```

Labels per language:

| Key | Value | ar | en |
|---|---|---|---|
| CAT_ITEM_KIND | STANDARD · BUNDLE | صنف عادي · حزمة | Standard item · Bundle |
| CAT_PUBLISH_STATE | UNPUBLISHED · PUBLISHED | غير منشور · منشور | Not published · Published |
| CAT_UOM | PIECE · CARTON · BOX · DOZEN · KILOGRAM · GRAM · METRE · LITRE | قطعة · كرتونة · علبة · دستة · كيلوجرام · جرام · متر · لتر | Piece · Carton · Box · Dozen · Kilogram · Gram · Metre · Litre |
| CAT_TAX_CLASS | STANDARD · ZERO_RATED · EXEMPT | خاضع للنسبة العامة · خاضع لنسبة صفر · معفى | Standard rate · Zero-rated · Exempt |
| CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE | GS1 · EGS | GS1 · EGS | GS1 · EGS |
| CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT | EA · KGM · GRM · MTR · LTR · CT · BX · DZN | وحدة · كيلوجرام · جرام · متر · لتر · كرتونة · علبة · دستة | Each · Kilogram · Gram · Metre · Litre · Carton · Box · Dozen |
| CAT_BARCODE_TYPE | GTIN · INTERNAL · SCALE | GTIN · داخلي · ميزان | GTIN · Internal · Scale |
| CAT_SCALE_VALUE_TYPE | WEIGHT · PRICE | وزن · سعر | Weight · Price |
| CAT_CHANGE_KIND | CREATED · UPDATED · DEACTIVATED · REACTIVATED | إنشاء · تعديل · إيقاف · إعادة تفعيل | Created · Updated · Deactivated · Reactivated |

Rationale:
- All keys are held in the core lookup module (`mdl`) and loaded at runtime [DP §5 G6].
- CAT_BRAND starts empty because the list belongs to the tenant.
- BAG (CAT_UOM) and H87 (CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT) are named in acceptance criteria as values added later; they are not seeded.

Consumed lookups: none.

## A7 — Status lifecycle

Only ENT-CAT-001 Item has more than two transitions; it combines isActiveFl and publishStateCode. No other entity has a status field with more than two states.

```
          create
            │
            ▼
   ┌──────────────────────┐   publish (RULE-CAT-041)  ┌──────────────────────┐
   │ ACTIVE · UNPUBLISHED │ ────────────────────────▶ │ ACTIVE · PUBLISHED   │
   │                      │ ◀──────────────────────── │                      │
   └──────────────────────┘        unpublish          └──────────────────────┘
        │        ▲                                            │
 deactivate      │ reactivate                                 │ deactivate
 (RULE-CAT-021,  │ (stays UNPUBLISHED)                        │ (RULE-CAT-041 sets
  RULE-CAT-048)  │                                            │  UNPUBLISHED)
        ▼        │                                            ▼
   ┌──────────────────────┐ ◀─────────────────────────────────┘
   │ INACTIVE·UNPUBLISHED │
   └──────────────────────┘
```

No module-specific approval flow: no story asks for one, and the profile forbids a workflow engine.

## A8 — Module dependencies

```yaml name=module-dependencies
consumes: []
```

CAT is first in the fixed module order and consumes no entity of another business module [KB:raw-idea.md §5]. Its uses of erp-core are given dependencies, listed in A9; they create no XM edge.

| External service | Purpose | Integration kind |
|---|---|---|
| — | CAT calls no external service; e-invoice submission to tax authorities belongs to TAX | — |

## A9 — Given usage

```yaml name=given-usage
rows:
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.mdl, via: com.erp.mdl.crossmodule.MdlLookupApi, purpose: "load the values of the CAT_* lookup keys (brand, unit of measure, tax class, e-invoice codes, barcode type, scale value type, item kind, publish state) at runtime"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.cu, via: com.erp.cu.crossmodule.SettingsApi, purpose: "read the `variants` and `bundles` capability flags behind the FeatureFlags API (ADR-CAT-041)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.sequence, via: com.erp.sequence.crossmodule.NumberSeriesApi, purpose: "issue Item codes (CAT_ITEM), Variant codes (CAT_VARIANT) and internal barcode digits (CAT_INTERNAL_BARCODE)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.file, via: com.erp.file.crossmodule.FileImageStoreApi, purpose: "save Item images in the public image storage and return their file reference"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.file, via: com.erp.file.crossmodule.FileDocumentLookupApi, purpose: "read the type and size of an uploaded image file for RULE-CAT-038"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.events, via: com.erp.events.OutboxPublisher, purpose: "record catalogue-change events in the change transaction and deliver them after commit (RULE-CAT-049)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.report, via: com.erp.report.crossmodule.PrintApi, purpose: "produce the printable barcode label document (REQ-CAT-102)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.report, via: com.erp.report.ReportProvider, purpose: "register the barcode label report of the catalogue"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.sec, via: com.erp.sec.permission.PermissionContributor, purpose: "register the CAT page codes so the security module derives their VIEW/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE permissions"}
```

No ENT re-creates an entity that a given provides. Tenant, User, Role, LookupType/LookupValue, FileDocument and NumberSeries are used, never re-declared [C:C-GIVEN-1].

# PART B — SCREEN REQUIREMENTS

## SCR-REQ-CAT-001 — Items / الأصناف

### B1 — Definition
Purpose      : Find, create and maintain Items with their Variants, units, barcodes, Bundle components, images, e-invoice data and publish state.
Entities     : ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-002, ENT-CAT-005, ENT-CAT-007, ENT-CAT-008, ENT-CAT-009, ENT-CAT-010, ENT-CAT-006 (reference)
Operations   : search, list, create, read, update, deactivate, reactivate, publish, unpublish, generate Variants, deactivate Variant, e-invoice override, add/deactivate Item unit, add GTIN / generate internal / add scale barcode, deactivate barcode, add/update/remove image, maintain Bundle components
Users        : Owner (all), Seller/cashier (read), Warehouse staff (read)
Navigation   : Catalog / الكتالوج → Items / الأصناف; from: home, global search result, Categories (Items of a Category); to: Variant attributes, Barcode labels, Item import
Content shape: header + repeating lines (Variants, Item units, barcodes, Bundle components, images)
Traces       : REQ-CAT-001 … REQ-CAT-007, REQ-CAT-014 … REQ-CAT-020, REQ-CAT-024 … REQ-CAT-035, REQ-CAT-049 … REQ-CAT-063, REQ-CAT-072 … REQ-CAT-091, REQ-CAT-096, REQ-CAT-105 … REQ-CAT-119
Composite    : Search + Entry — one screen requirement

### B2 — Search / list
| Filter | Source | Result column |
|---|---|---|
| Text (nameAr, nameEn, code, barcode) | ENT-CAT-001.nameAr / nameEn / code; ENT-CAT-009.barcodeValue | code, nameAr, nameEn |
| Category | ENT-CAT-001.categoryFk → ENT-CAT-006 | Category nameAr |
| Brand | ENT-CAT-001.brandCode — CAT_BRAND | Brand |
| Item kind (shown only while `bundles` is on — REQ-CAT-015) | ENT-CAT-001.itemKindCode — CAT_ITEM_KIND | Item kind |
| Publish state | ENT-CAT-001.publishStateCode — CAT_PUBLISH_STATE | Publish state |
| Active | ENT-CAT-001.isActiveFl | Active |

Sorted by nameAr (REQ-CAT-003). Applies REQ-CAT-014 and REQ-CAT-015 to filters.

### B3 — Input
- **Header (mandatory, outside Advanced — 4 fields, REQ-CAT-026):** ENT-CAT-001.nameAr, baseUomCode (pre-filled PIECE), taxClassCode (pre-filled STANDARD), itemKindCode (pre-filled STANDARD; shown while `bundles` is on).
- **Header (read-only):** ENT-CAT-001.code, publishStateCode, isActiveFl.
- **Advanced:** ENT-CAT-001.nameEn, categoryFk, brandCode, descriptionAr, descriptionEn, einvoiceCodeTypeCode, einvoiceCode.
- **Variants section (while `variants` is on — REQ-CAT-014):** ENT-CAT-002 lines (code, derived names, attribute values from ENT-CAT-005, e-invoice override, isActiveFl). The action "Generate variants" selects values of ENT-CAT-003/ENT-CAT-004.
- **Units section:** ENT-CAT-008 lines (uomCode, conversionFactor, isPurchaseFl, isSalesFl).
- **Barcodes section:** ENT-CAT-009 lines per Variant (barcodeValue, barcodeTypeCode, uomCode). SCALE is offered per REQ-CAT-096.
- **Bundle components section (kind BUNDLE, while `bundles` is on):** ENT-CAT-007 lines (componentVariantFk, quantity, sortOrder).
- **Images section:** ENT-CAT-010 lines (file, nameAr, nameEn, variantFk, sortOrder, isPrimaryFl).

| Action | Operation | RULEs applied |
|---|---|---|
| Save | create (REQ-CAT-024, REQ-CAT-025) / update (REQ-CAT-004) | RULE-CAT-001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006, 007, 022, 026, 042 |
| Deactivate / Reactivate | REQ-CAT-005 / REQ-CAT-006 | RULE-CAT-021, 041, 048 |
| Publish / Unpublish | REQ-CAT-113 / REQ-CAT-114 | RULE-CAT-041 |
| Generate variants | REQ-CAT-049 | RULE-CAT-008, 012, 013, 014, 020 |
| Deactivate variant | REQ-CAT-050 | RULE-CAT-015, 021, 048 |
| Save variant e-invoice override | REQ-CAT-118 | RULE-CAT-042 |
| Add unit / change flags / deactivate unit | REQ-CAT-077 / 078 / 079 | RULE-CAT-027, 028, 048 |
| Add GTIN / Generate internal barcode / Add scale code | REQ-CAT-083 / 084 / 096 | RULE-CAT-029, 030, 031, 032, 033 |
| Deactivate barcode | REQ-CAT-085 | RULE-CAT-048 |
| Save Bundle components | REQ-CAT-056, REQ-CAT-057 | RULE-CAT-008, 018, 019 |
| Upload / update / remove image | REQ-CAT-105 / 106 / 107 | RULE-CAT-038, 039, 040 |
| Import items | opens SCR-REQ-CAT-004 | — |
| Print labels | opens SCR-REQ-CAT-005 | — |

### B4 — Access
Page code: CAT_ITEMS (one SEC_PAGES row)

| Role | VIEW | CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Seller/cashier | ✓ | — | — | — |
| Warehouse staff | ✓ | — | — | — |

## Decisions applied

| DEFAULT / ADR | What | Source | Override / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-01 | Every Item has ≥ 1 Variant (a default Variant). Stock, price, barcode and e-invoice override attach to the Variant | DP §8 P-04; registry OI-07 | Change if P-04 is decided otherwise |
| D-02 | Brand and unit of measure are mdl lookup keys CAT_BRAND / CAT_UOM owned by CAT | DP §8 P-05; PRD US-CAT-014 Source (module-registry LOOKUPS OWNED) | Make them CAT entities if attributes per brand are needed |
| D-03 | Category is a CAT tree, at most 5 levels; Items attach at any level | DP §8 P-05; US-CAT-013 | Change the depth limit |
| D-04 | Bundle composition lives in CAT (Item kind BUNDLE + component lines). No nested Bundles; a Bundle has one Variant; the kind is fixed after first save | DP §8 P-06; US-CAT-012 | Allow nesting through a later delta |
| D-05 | Barcodes: 0..n per Variant, each bound to a unit. Internal barcodes are EAN-13 with GS1 restricted-circulation prefix 04 and digits from series CAT_INTERNAL_BARCODE. Scale codes are SCALE barcodes | DP §8 P-07; module-registry OI-10 | Change the internal prefix |
| D-06 | E-invoice code type and code on the Item, with an optional override on the Variant | US-CAT-021; DP §8 P-08 | Move to Variant-only |
| D-07 | nameAr mandatory with ≥ 1 Arabic letter; nameEn optional, with nameAr used in its place | PRD P-3; DP §8 P-09 | Drop the Arabic-letter check |
| D-08 | Image files are kept in the given `file` public image storage; CAT holds order, main image, Variant binding and descriptions | DP §8 P-12; registry OI-15 | — |
| D-09 | New Item defaults: kind STANDARD, base unit PIECE, tax class STANDARD, publish state UNPUBLISHED | KB:raw-idea.md §6.1; US-CAT-007 | Change the default values |
| D-10 | Limits: 3 attributes and 300 active Variants per Item; 20 images of ≤ 5 MB; import ≤ 10 MB and ≤ 5,000 rows; search ≥ 2 characters and ≤ 20 results; 1–999 copies and ≤ 5,000 labels per request | KB:raw-idea.md §6.1, §6.10 (bounded, fast setup) | Raise any limit |
| D-11 | Number series CAT_ITEM (pattern ITM-000001), CAT_VARIANT (VAR-000001), CAT_INTERNAL_BARCODE (10 digits) | profile NUMBERING rule; US-CAT-009 | Change the patterns in the core sequence module |
| D-12 | CAT_UOM seeds PIECE, CARTON, BOX, DOZEN, KILOGRAM, GRAM, METRE, LITRE, mapped to e-invoice units EA, CT, BX, DZN, KGM, GRM, MTR, LTR | US-CAT-021 Source (Egypt ETA SDK unitType) | Re-map against the authority's published code table |
| D-13 | Two active Items cannot share one nameAr | KB:raw-idea.md §6.5 (next action: open the existing Item); US-CAT-001 | Turn into a warning |
| D-14 | Base unit and Item unit conversion factor are fixed after first save | US-CAT-015 (purchasing, selling and stock agree on quantities) | Allow change while no downstream document exists (needs a downstream check) |
| D-15 | Variant names are derived from the Item name and the value names, never entered | US-CAT-011 | Add an owner override name |
| ADR-CAT-038 | The project-registry open items affecting CAT (OI-06 … OI-12, OI-15) are applied per the approved PRD sources and DP §8 recommendations | project-registry §8; PRD | ACCEPTED (non-breaking) |
| ADR-CAT-039 | Dependent records take their parent's kind and carry the audit fields and isActiveFl | profile entity kinds | ACCEPTED (non-breaking) |

# UI/UX spec — Catalog / الكتالوج (CAT) — v2

Module : CAT · Version : v2 · Stage : P3.2 Part A · Profile : commerce
Inputs : srs (SCR-REQ-CAT-001 … 006, ENT/RULE/permission matrix), prd (US-CAT-001 … 022)
Mints  : SCR-CAT-001 … SCR-CAT-006 · UXD-CAT-001 … UXD-CAT-003 (both streams start at 001; the current state holds no earlier frontend design)
Decisions: ADR-CAT-049 (Items: one Save, ordered calls) · ADR-CAT-050 (display data served by the given) · ADR-CAT-051 (API coverage, binding notes)

This is a delta run, but the current state holds no earlier ui-ux-spec, so every block below is ADDED. Screens follow the composite-screen rule: Search + Entry and Master + Detail are ONE screen with ONE `SCR-*`, and the sub-views sit under it. Fields and permissions are copied from the SRS, and labels are given in ar and en. The spec states intent. Components, hooks and routes in code belong to the frontend execution plan.

## Conventions shared by every screen

- **Direction and language**: RTL in ar, LTR in en. Every label, button, notice and message is given in both. Server messages are shown from the envelope's `messageAr` / `messageEn`, never composed (ADR-CAT-048).
- **Progressive disclosure**: a record surface shows its mandatory fields first; the rest sit under "Advanced / متقدم", collapsed by default (REQ-CAT-026).
- **Read-only access**: a user with VIEW only sees the same surface with every input read-only and every action hidden.
- **Capability flags** (UXD-CAT-002): a flag-bound field, pane, filter or menu entry is absent, not disabled, while its flag is off (REQ-CAT-014, REQ-CAT-015).
- **Lookup fields** (UXD-CAT-001): options are the active values of the field's lookup key, labelled per language. A deactivated value already on a record is still shown, with its label, on that record (REQ-CAT-076).
- **Deactivate**: a record is never deleted. "Deactivate / إيقاف" asks for confirmation and then shows the server's RULE-CAT-048 notice.
- **States** (every screen): empty (the next action is offered) · loading (skeleton in the area being read) · error (generic localized message from the envelope, with "Try again / أعد المحاولة") · offline: the SRS sets no offline requirement for CAT, so only the platform's connection indicator is shown.

Shared UX copy (not catalogue messages):

| Key | ar | en |
|---|---|---|
| advanced | متقدم | Advanced |
| save | حفظ | Save |
| cancel | إلغاء | Cancel |
| confirm | تأكيد | Confirm |
| deactivate | إيقاف | Deactivate |
| reactivate | إعادة تفعيل | Reactivate |
| try-again | أعد المحاولة | Try again |
| unsaved-leave | لديك تغييرات غير محفوظة. هل تريد المغادرة دون حفظ؟ | You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving? |
| stale-version | عدّل مستخدم آخر هذا السجل. أعد تحميله ثم أعد تطبيق تغييراتك. | Someone else changed this record. Reload it, then apply your changes again. |
| pending-badge | سيُحفظ عند الحفظ | Saved on Save |
| partial-save | حُفظ جزء من التغييرات. السطر المعلَّم لم يُحفظ؛ صحّحه ثم اضغط حفظ لإكمال الباقي. | Part of the changes was saved. The marked line was not saved; correct it, then press Save to finish the rest. |
| save-first | احفظ تغييراتك أولًا. | Save your changes first. |
| flag-unreadable | (RULE-CAT-009 message, SRS) | (RULE-CAT-009 message, SRS) |

Pane action: "Generate variants / توليد المتغيّرات" opens the Variant generation picker. It is absent for a BUNDLE Item (RULE-CAT-020). The picker's summary row in the pane shows the pending selection ("SIZE: M, L · COLOUR: أحمر, أزرق — Edit").

**Variant generation picker** (second level): it lists the active attributes (ENT-CAT-003 code / nameAr — الرمز / Code, الاسم بالعربية / Arabic name) with their active values (ENT-CAT-004 code / nameAr), ordered by sortOrder. Up to 3 attributes, multi-select of values per attribute. Confirm returns the selection to the form; Cancel discards the draft. The picker saves nothing. When no active attribute exists, it shows "Open Variant attributes / افتح خصائص المتغيّرات".

Value lines — code الرمز / Code (mandatory; read-only after creation) · nameAr الاسم بالعربية / Arabic name (mandatory) · nameEn الاسم بالإنجليزية / English name · sortOrder الترتيب / Sort order · isActiveFl نشط / Active (changed by the line's Deactivate). List row: code, nameAr, nameEn, active, value count
Composition       : container drawer · attribute record → none · values → summary row + second level · submits: one
Permissions       : PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_VIEW (gateway) · PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_CREATE · PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_UPDATE · PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_DELETE — Owner: VIEW, CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE · Seller/cashier: VIEW · Warehouse staff: VIEW (SRS B4)

States            : empty — no attribute: "No variant attributes yet" + "New attribute" · flag off: RULE-CAT-008 text with «variants» (direct link while the flag is off) · loading · error (generic) · offline (not required by the SRS)

The "Values" summary row shows the active value count and a capped preview of the first 5 value names in sortOrder, with an "Edit values / تعديل القيم" trigger. The values editor is a second-level drawer, a sibling of the entry drawer, opened from `&values=open`. It lists the value lines in the body's own scroll, offers "Add value / إضافة قيمة" (a new line), reorder, and Deactivate per line (marked pending). Confirm returns the edited set to the entry's form state; Cancel discards the draft. The editor saves nothing. The entry's Save is the one save.

# ADR-CAT-002 — A new level-0 module `SET` owns FeatureFlags, presets and the setup wizard
Status      : RESOLVED-IN-DIALOGUE
Stage       : domain-profile        Module: CAT        Version: v1
Lane        : analysis-dialogue · round 2 · claude:sonnet
Decided     : 2026-10-22T14:34:22+00:00
Dialogue-key: 704d65c188d6
traces      : —

## Decision
Amend P-02 option A. KB §7 allows preset reads only in settings, so there must be exactly one owner. I named it `SET` (context `configuration`). It persists through given `cu` and depends on no business module, so the fixed DAG order and delivery tiers are unchanged. I rejected putting it in Catalog (wrong context, and CAT would become everyone's dependency).
traces: KB §4.1, §6.9, §7; G1, G2, G3; block 4 row 15

# ADR-CAT-008 — A Variant carries tax-classification codes tagged by scheme, with schemes owned by TAX
Status      : RESOLVED-IN-DIALOGUE
Stage       : domain-profile        Module: CAT        Version: v1
Lane        : analysis-dialogue · round 2 · claude:sonnet
Decided     : 2026-10-22T14:34:22+00:00
Dialogue-key: 4d603a9614d0
traces      : —

## Decision
Amend P-08. Round 1 named ETA GS1/EGS directly, but that is unverified, so the decision is scheme-agnostic: CAT stores the codes, and TAX defines the schemes as `mdl` lookups and validates them through a crossmodule API. # ADR-CAT-013 — Sales & POS, SerialWarranty and Storefront use the profile codes SLS, SWR and SFR; the aliases SAL, SRW and STF are retired
Status      : RESOLVED-IN-DIALOGUE
Stage       : P0        Module: CAT        Version: v2
Lane        : analysis-dialogue · round 2 · claude:sonnet
Decided     : 2026-10-26T09:46:00+00:00
Dialogue-key: ec10031a4681
traces      : —

## Decision
traces: OI-01, OI-04
Accept option A. `profile.vocabulary.module_prefixes` already holds all 14 codes, and the engine's detection table uses SLS, SWR and SFR. Option B would change the profile and break C3.7 until it was done. I amend one point: no ID is ever minted with an alias, and the domain-profile spellings (§4, §7.1–7.3) are corrected at its hand re-run, which OI-02 already requires. The other 11 codes lose the label "PROPOSED" because the registry (§2.2) marks them IN PROFILE.
Sources: registry §2.2; engine §2.1.

# ADR-CAT-017 — Capability flags and activity presets live in the given `cu`, behind a `FeatureFlags` library facade; no new module is created
Status      : RESOLVED-IN-DIALOGUE
Stage       : P0        Module: CAT        Version: v2

Dialogue-key: 868cbb2e9151
traces      : POL-CAT-002, POL-CAT-003, POL-CAT-004, POL-CAT-005

## Decision
traces: OI-05, POL-CAT-002, POL-CAT-003, POL-CAT-004, POL-CAT-005
Accept B and tighten it, because round 1 left two candidates ownerless:
- Flag values are the given `AppConfiguration` and get no entity ID. Activity presets are seeded settings defined by the flag × activity matrix in the platform summary. CAND-OPEN-003 and CAND-OPEN-004 are therefore closed as "given, no entity ID". No business module owns them.
- The facade is a shared-kernel library, not a module, and it owns no ID. It reaches `cu` only through `SettingsApi`, so G5 holds.
- Each module owns the flag-off guard for its own flags.
- The five-step setup wizard is a front-end shell with no domain entity. Each step calls its owning module: company is `tenant`, activity preset is `cu`, tax and e-invoice is TAX, payment methods is STL, item import is CAT.
- Option A would duplicate `cu` and needs a prefix the profile doesn't have. Option C would force PTY → CAT and break PTY's root status.
Sources: KB header, §3 D2, §4.1, §6.2, §6.9; manifest `cu`, `tenant`; G5, G6.

## Decision

# ADR-CAT-033 — Story priority is given only where the knowledge base states or clearly implies it
Status      : RESOLVED-IN-DIALOGUE
Stage       : P0.5        Module: CAT        Version: v2
Lane        : analysis-dialogue · round 2 · claude:sonnet
Decided     : 2026-10-26T14:56:26+00:00
Dialogue-key: 033ab8504db3
traces      : POL-CAT-001, POL-CAT-002, POL-CAT-003, POL-CAT-004, POL-CAT-005, POL-CAT-006, POL-CAT-007, POL-CAT-008, POL-CAT-009

## Decision
Accepted. Option A would discard real signal in §4.2 and §8. The rule is applied the same way to every story:
- **HIGH:** the §6 simplicity requirements (made measurable by D9), the fixed decision D2, the §2 e-invoicing driver, the differentiator of §1, and variants and bundles (required by the first two launch presets in §4.2).
- **MEDIUM:** storefront-facing stories, because the storefront goes live in wave 2 (§8.2).
- **LOW:** weighed items, because produce and meat by weight is not in the launch priority of §4.2.
- **"—":** everything else.
Priority orders attention inside CAT only. Per D10, CAT ships whole in wave 1.
traces: POL-CAT-001, POL-CAT-002, POL-CAT-003, POL-CAT-004, POL-CAT-005, POL-CAT-006, POL-CAT-007, POL-CAT-008, POL-CAT-009

# ADR-CAT-038 — Basis for the catalogue model while project-registry open items are OPEN

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-26

## Context
The P1 reading protocol requires the project-registry open-question index to be empty for the module. The project registry (bootstrap 1.0.0) still lists the following items as OPEN for P0 dialogue:
- OI-06 (custom attribute seams)
- OI-07 (Item/Variant model)
- OI-08 (brand, unit of measure, Category)
- OI-09 (bundle owner)
- OI-10 (barcodes and scale codes)
- OI-11 (e-invoice obligations)
- OI-12 (name languages)
- OI-15 (media)

The approved PRD (gate prd-approval) cites the module registry's resolutions of the same points: OI-06, OI-07, OI-09, OI-10, OI-12 and OI-15, plus LOOKUPS OWNED brand and unit-of-measure. The domain-profile §8 gives a recommendation for each one (P-03 … P-09, P-12). Questions are forbidden at P1.

## Decision
The SRS applies the approved PRD sources and, where they are silent, the domain-profile §8 recommendations:
- every Item has ≥ 1 Variant (P-04)
- Category is a CAT tree, and brand and unit of measure are CAT-owned mdl lookup keys (P-05)
- bundle composition lives in CAT (P-06)
- a Variant carries 0..n barcodes, and scale codes need no new flag (P-07, OI-10)
- the e-invoice code is held on the Item with a Variant override (P-08)
- the Arabic name is mandatory and the English name optional (P-09, PRD P-3)
- image files live in given `file`, and CAT holds order, main image and descriptions (P-12)

Each point is recorded as DEFAULT D-01 … D-08 in the SRS "Decisions applied".

## Consequences
- The SRS is complete without reopening the PRD.
- If a later P0 dialogue closes an OI differently, the affected ENT/REQ/RULE ids change in a delta version (MODIFIED), not by rewriting this one.
- The orchestrator should mark these OIs as applied for CAT in project-registry §8.

## Traces
US-CAT-005, US-CAT-008, US-CAT-011, US-CAT-012, US-CAT-013, US-CAT-014, US-CAT-016, US-CAT-017, US-CAT-019, US-CAT-021 · ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-002, ENT-CAT-006, ENT-CAT-007, ENT-CAT-009, ENT-CAT-010 · REQ-CAT-025, REQ-CAT-049, REQ-CAT-056, REQ-CAT-083, REQ-CAT-105, REQ-CAT-117

# ADR-CAT-039 — Kind of dependent records

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-26

## Context
The profile allows only the entity kinds master, transactional, lookup, config and security, and gives each kind default fields. Several CAT records exist only inside one parent master record and are never addressed alone outside it:
- Variant attribute assignment
- Bundle component
- Item unit
- Barcode
- Item media

The master defaults (code, nameAr, nameEn) have no natural meaning for most of these records. Profile check CM-1 requires master entities to carry the master defaults.

## Decision
A dependent record is classified with its parent's kind (master). It carries isActiveFl and the audit fields. The identity defaults (code, nameAr, nameEn) are carried in one of two ways:
- **by the parent:** Variant attribute assignment, Bundle component and Item unit carry no code or names of their own;
- **under a named field:** for Barcode, barcodeValue serves as the code; for Item media, nameAr/nameEn are the image descriptions.

## Consequences
- No new kind is invented.
- The database stage gives these tables audit columns and isActiveFl, and no business-number column.

## Traces
ENT-CAT-005, ENT-CAT-007, ENT-CAT-008, ENT-CAT-009, ENT-CAT-010 · US-CAT-011, US-CAT-012, US-CAT-015, US-CAT-016, US-CAT-019

<<<END ADR>>>

# ADR-CAT-040 — Tax class held as a CAT-owned lookup

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-26

## Context
US-CAT-021 asks to record each Item's tax class. The domain-profile P-08 (pending) recommends a tax-category reference owned by TAX (registry CAND-TAX-001, OPEN OI-11). However, CAT is first in the fixed module order and depends on no business module, and dependencies flow downward only [KB:raw-idea.md §5]. A CAT reference to a TAX entity would invert that order.

## Decision
The tax class is the lookup CAT_TAX_CLASS (in mdl, owned by CAT):
- seeded with STANDARD, ZERO_RATED and EXEMPT
- open, so the tenant can add values
- defaulted to STANDARD on new Items

The TAX module later maps each tax class to its rates and authority codes. CAT holds no rate.

## Consequences
- CAT stays free of business dependencies.
- TAX consumes CAT_TAX_CLASS read-only.
- If P-08 later decides otherwise, the TAX SRS takes ownership of the key, and CAT's taxClassCode is re-pointed in a delta.

## Traces
US-CAT-021 · ENT-CAT-001 · REQ-CAT-004, REQ-CAT-024, REQ-CAT-119 · RULE-CAT-006

<<<END ADR>>>

# ADR-CAT-041 — Capability flags read through settings; turn-off check offered to the flag owner

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-26

## Context
The following are still OPEN:
- who owns the FeatureFlags API, the activity presets and the setup wizard (P-02, OI-05)
- how a flag is persisted: through given `cu` SettingsApi (DP §4 #15)

US-CAT-003 requires CAT behaviour to follow the flags. US-CAT-006 requires turning `variants` or `bundles` off to be blocked while catalogue data depends on it (G3). CAT cannot block a change in a module it does not own, and the flag owner cannot read CAT data unless CAT offers it.

## Decision
- CAT reads `variants` and `bundles` through com.erp.cu.crossmodule.SettingsApi, behind the FeatureFlags API name.
- When the value is unreadable, CAT refuses the flag-bound operation (RULE-CAT-009).
- CAT offers a turn-off check operation (REQ-CAT-021 … REQ-CAT-023). It returns allowed / count / dependent Items, and the flag owner calls it before persisting a turn-off.
- The catalogue settings screen shows the same check to the owner.

## Consequences
- The flag owner's SRS (once P-02 assigns a code) must call the CAT turn-off check.
- The P1.5 contract stage defines the check as a CAT cross-module operation.
- No activity name or preset is read by CAT (G1).

## Traces
US-CAT-003, US-CAT-004, US-CAT-006 · ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-002, ENT-CAT-005 · REQ-CAT-011, REQ-CAT-013, REQ-CAT-021, REQ-CAT-022, REQ-CAT-023 · RULE-CAT-008, RULE-CAT-009, RULE-CAT-010, RULE-CAT-011

# ADR-CAT-042 — Scale label layouts and unit e-invoice codes as CAT config entities

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-26

## Context
- US-CAT-017 (module-registry OI-10) calls the scale-barcode layout "a tenant setting".
- US-CAT-021 asks that units carry their e-invoice unit. Units of measure are mdl lookup values, and no given interface in the manifest is known to hold an extra attribute per lookup value.
- The rules that check scale codes and decode labels need a `Data source` that resolves to declared ENT fields (C5.12). A key-value setting in given `cu` would leave those rules without one.

## Decision
- Scale label layouts are the CAT config entity ENT-CAT-011, one per tenant prefix; this still counts as a tenant setting.
- The e-invoice unit of each unit of measure is the CAT config entity ENT-CAT-012, with lookup CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT.
- Both are maintained on the Catalogue settings screen (SCR-REQ-CAT-006).

## Why this is not a settings table (F5)
ENT-CAT-011 and ENT-CAT-012 are reference data. Each row is a keyed, versioned record with its own business key, active flag and rules (RULE-CAT-034, RULE-CAT-043), and other records are checked against them (RULE-CAT-032, 033, 035). They are not free-form key/value settings. The capability flags remain the only settings, in the given `cu`.

## Consequences
- RULE-CAT-032 … RULE-CAT-035 and RULE-CAT-043 are enforceable, with declared data sources.
- Nothing provided by erp-core is rebuilt; the given `cu` keeps the capability flags only.

## Traces
US-CAT-017, US-CAT-021 · ENT-CAT-011, ENT-CAT-012 · REQ-CAT-092 … REQ-CAT-100, REQ-CAT-120 … REQ-CAT-124

<<<END ADR>>>

# ADR-CAT-043 — Catalogue search contributes to the global search

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-26

## Context
US-CAT-022 asks to find Items from "the one global search (items, customers, documents)" [KB:raw-idea.md §6.6]. That search spans several modules. No CAT story or policy owns the search box itself, and the erp-core manifest lists no search-aggregation extension point.

## Decision
CAT exposes a catalogue search operation (REQ-CAT-125 … REQ-CAT-127):
- the term must have ≥ 2 characters
- it returns ≤ 20 active Items, with exact code and barcode matches first
- access is checked against VIEW on CAT_ITEMS

The global search box is composed outside CAT: in the shared frontend shell, or by the module that later owns it. It calls each module's search operation. CAT declares no screen requirement for the search box.

## Consequences
- Party (customers) and the document modules offer equivalent search operations in their own SRS.
- The UX stage (P3.2) places the global search box in the shell.

## Traces
US-CAT-022 · ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-009 · REQ-CAT-125, REQ-CAT-126, REQ-CAT-127 · RULE-CAT-046

<<<ADR: ADR-CAT-044.md>>>
# ADR-CAT-044 — Platform-standard error rows of the CAT backend

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P3.1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-28

## Context
The SRS RULEs cover every business refusal of the catalogue, but an endpoint can also fail for reasons no RULE names: the caller is not authenticated, lacks the page permission, names a record that does not exist (or belongs to another tenant — contract §0 "a record of another tenant reads as not found"), sends a malformed body, sends a stale `version`, uploads a file above the server's multipart limit or of a content type the endpoint does not read, or the server fails. The engine requires these to be Error Catalog rows with rule `PLATFORM-STD` and an ADR. The SRS gives no message text for them.

## Decision
The plan's Error Catalog carries eight `PLATFORM-STD` rows, each an instance of `{MOD}-{http}[-{SLUG}]`:

| Code | HTTP | Raised when |
|---|---|---|
| CAT-400-REQUEST-INVALID | 400 | body or parameter missing, of the wrong type, or failing a declared length/format before any RULE runs |
| CAT-401-UNAUTHENTICATED | 401 | no valid bearer token |
| CAT-403-FORBIDDEN | 403 | the caller lacks the endpoint's `PERM_<PAGE_CODE>_<ACTION>` |
| CAT-404-NOT-FOUND | 404 | the identifier names no record of the caller's tenant |
| CAT-409-STALE-VERSION | 409 | the `version` echoed by an update differs from the stored one (optimistic lock) |
| CAT-413-PAYLOAD-TOO-LARGE | 413 | the multipart request exceeds the server limit before the service sees it |
| CAT-415-UNSUPPORTED-MEDIA-TYPE | 415 | the request content type is not the one the endpoint reads |
| CAT-500-SERVER-ERROR | 500 | any unexpected failure; the transaction rolls back and no event is delivered |

Their message text is the given platform's standard `LocalizedException` text (messageAr / messageEn); CAT invents none. Failures that a RULE names (number series — RULE-CAT-005, capability flags — RULE-CAT-009, rolled-back change — RULE-CAT-049) keep their own rows. No row describes a network failure: every given and module interface is in-process.

## Consequences
- The API document answers every operation with the rows it can raise; the frontend shows the envelope's messages.
- A ninth infrastructure case is a new row and a revision of this ADR's successor, never a free-text error.

## Traces
REQ-CAT-001 · REQ-CAT-010 · REQ-CAT-035 · REQ-CAT-110 · REQ-CAT-040 · RULE-CAT-049

<<<END ADR>>>

<<<ADR: ADR-CAT-045.md>>>
# ADR-CAT-045 — Endpoint surface beyond SRS B5 and the in-process contract interface

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P3.1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-28

## Context
The contract (P1.5) promises eleven read operations (CON-CAT-007 … CON-CAT-017) and one event (CON-CAT-018) to other modules, as in-process promises (`conventions.module_interface: in_process`). SRS B5 gives HTTP endpoints for most of them, but four have none: read a Variant (CON-CAT-008, REQ-CAT-119), read an Item unit (CON-CAT-009), the storefront catalogue read (CON-CAT-014, REQ-CAT-115) and the catalogue search (CON-CAT-016, REQ-CAT-125). SCR-REQ-CAT-003 also names the operation "read" for Variant attributes, with no B5 endpoint. REQ-CAT-127 asks that a caller without VIEW on CAT_ITEMS gets no catalogue-search result, which the contract states as "forbidden — answered as an empty result".

## Decision
1. CAT publishes one in-process interface, `com.erp.cat.crossmodule.CatalogueReadApi`, with one method per contract operation (getItem, getVariant, getItemUnit, lookupBarcode, getCategory, getCategoryTree, listCategoryItems, listStorefrontItems, getVariantImages, searchCatalogue, checkCapabilityTurnOff). Each method delegates to the same service method as the HTTP endpoint of the operation, so both surfaces return the same data.
2. The plan adds five HTTP endpoints so that every contract operation and every screen operation has one: `GET /api/v1/cat/variants/{id}`, `GET /api/v1/cat/item-units/{id}`, `GET /api/v1/cat/variant-attributes/{id}`, `GET /api/v1/cat/storefront-items`, `GET /api/v1/cat/catalogue-search`. All are guarded by the VIEW permission of their screen.
3. The storefront HTTP endpoint is a back-office preview guarded by `PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW`. Shoppers never call CAT; the storefront module reaches the same data through `CatalogueReadApi.listStorefrontItems`.
4. The catalogue search checks `PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW` before searching; a caller without it receives success with an empty list (REQ-CAT-127), not 403.
5. The catalogue-change event (CON-CAT-018) is recorded by every mutating endpoint through the given `OutboxPublisher`.

## Consequences
- The frontend binds to the added endpoints through the API document; consumers bind to `CatalogueReadApi`.
- Adding a contract operation later adds one interface method and, when a screen needs it, one endpoint.

## Traces
CON-CAT-007 … CON-CAT-018 · REQ-CAT-115 · REQ-CAT-119 · REQ-CAT-125 · REQ-CAT-127 · REQ-CAT-048

<<<END ADR>>>

<<<ADR: ADR-CAT-046.md>>>
# ADR-CAT-046 — Security bootstrap (pages, permissions, preset-role grants) and tenant copies of CAT seeds

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P3.1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-28

## Context
SRS B4 declares six page codes and the actions each preset role holds on them (Owner, Seller/cashier, Warehouse staff). The SRS Access summary says the given `sec` module derives permission names from the page codes and that CAT seeds none. The given-usage row for `sec` names `com.erp.sec.permission.PermissionContributor`. Registering a page and deriving a permission is not a grant: without the role grants every endpoint answers 403 to every caller. The db-script seeds lookup values, number series and Unit e-invoice codes for the PLATFORM tenant (TENANT_ID 1) and states that "new tenants receive copies through the given provisioning contributors"; no given-usage row names such a contributor.

## Decision
1. `CatPermissionContributor` (implements the given `PermissionContributor`) registers the six page codes CAT_ITEMS, CAT_CATEGORIES, CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES, CAT_ITEM_IMPORT, CAT_BARCODE_LABELS and CAT_SETTINGS, each with the actions SRS B4 uses. The given `sec` module derives the names `PERM_<PAGE_CODE>_<ACTION>` (e.g. `PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW`).
2. The default grants of the three preset roles are exactly SRS B4. They are produced by the contributor's default-grant declaration where the given `PermissionContributor` offers one; otherwise by a CAT application migration (`V1000+`) that inserts the grant rows for the preset roles into the given's role-permission data. The executor confirms which of the two the given 1.6.0 supports from the `erp-core-usage` skill before coding.
3. Copies of the CAT seeds for tenants other than PLATFORM follow the db-script statement (given provisioning). If the given requires an explicit module contributor for that, it is a given-usage row the SRS adds in a later delta; this plan adds none.

## Consequences
- The `bootstrap` block of the plan names every page permission with its grant and its producer.
- Custom roles receive CAT actions through the given `sec` screens only.

## Traces
REQ-CAT-127 · REQ-CAT-001 · REQ-CAT-073 · REQ-CAT-074 · REQ-CAT-032 · REQ-CAT-095

<<<END ADR>>>

<<<ADR: ADR-CAT-047.md>>>
# ADR-CAT-047 — Repository deviations and concurrency guards

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P3.1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-28

## Context
Several catalogue reads cross entities or walk a hierarchy (Category tree and sub-trees, the catalogue search ranking, the capability turn-off check, Variant search with the first barcode, barcode lookup, derived Variant names). Several writes decide on a value they then write (last active Variant, at most 300 Variants, unique combinations, exactly one main image, at most 20 images, Category cycles, barcode/scale-prefix clashes, components of active Bundles). The engine requires an ADR for every join, native query and non-default lock, and an answer for every read-then-write.

## Decision
**Native queries / joins**
- Category tree, ancestors, descendants and "Items of a Category" use PostgreSQL recursive CTEs on CAT_CATEGORY (QR-CAT-006, QR-CAT-037).
- The catalogue search (QR-CAT-008) and the turn-off check (QR-CAT-009) are native aggregate queries.
- Variant search (QR-CAT-016), barcode lookup (QR-CAT-052), derived Variant names (QR-CAT-019) and images of a Variant (QR-CAT-058) join CAT tables only. No lookup label is joined: the backend returns codes.

**Locks** (all inside the request transaction, released at commit)
- Item-scoped mutations (generate Variants, deactivate Variant, publish, deactivate Item, Bundle components, media changes, Item unit add) first lock the CAT_ITEM row with `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` (QR-CAT-010). Every guard about "the Variants / images / units / lines of one Item" is decided under that lock.
- Component Variants of a Bundle, and their Items, are read `FOR SHARE` (QR-CAT-017); deactivating a Variant or an Item takes the Item lock and then counts active Bundles (QR-CAT-042), so a deactivation and a Bundle save never both pass.
- Variant attributes and values chosen for generation are read `FOR SHARE` (QR-CAT-031); their deactivation locks the row `FOR UPDATE` before counting usage (QR-CAT-021).
- Category moves and creates take `pg_advisory_xact_lock` on the key (TENANT_ID, 'CAT_CATEGORY_TREE') before the cycle and depth check (QR-CAT-037); Category deactivation locks the Category row and Items assigned to a Category read it `FOR SHARE`.
- GTIN / INTERNAL barcode adds and scale-label-layout creates take `pg_advisory_xact_lock` on (TENANT_ID, 'CAT_SCALE_PREFIX') before RULE-CAT-032 is checked.
- Every "unique among active records" rule is finally held by the db-script's partial unique indexes; a unique violation is translated to the RULE's catalog row (never to 500).
- Codes and internal barcode digits come from the given `NumberSeriesApi`, whose allocation is atomic; UQ_CAT_ITEM_CODE / UQ_CAT_VARIANT_CODE / UQ_CAT_BARCODE_VALUE back it.

## Consequences
- The implementer rewrites each QR with the project's query strategy but keeps the lock each QR names.
- Lock order is always Item → Variant → line rows, to avoid deadlocks.

## Traces
REQ-CAT-049 · REQ-CAT-051 · REQ-CAT-052 · REQ-CAT-053 · REQ-CAT-062 · REQ-CAT-067 · REQ-CAT-068 · REQ-CAT-069 · REQ-CAT-087 · REQ-CAT-091 · REQ-CAT-106 · REQ-CAT-110 · REQ-CAT-111 · REQ-CAT-021 · REQ-CAT-125

<<<END ADR>>>

<<<ADR: ADR-CAT-048.md>>>
# ADR-CAT-048 — Endpoint shapes, derived response properties and success-path messages

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P3.1 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-28

## Context
SRS B5 states verbs, paths and inputs but leaves some shapes open: one PATCH for reactivate / publish / unpublish; a new Bundle that must carry its components on its first save (AC-CAT-058, AC-CAT-061); an import that returns a result; two binary documents (import sheet, label document); response properties that have no column (derived Variant names — D-15, D-P2-08; the English display fallback — REQ-CAT-029; effective e-invoice data — REQ-CAT-119; the e-invoice unit of a unit — CON-CAT-008/009; the embedded scale value — REQ-CAT-097); and several RULEs whose message is shown on success (RULE-CAT-010, 011, 012, 039, 045, 048).

## Decision
1. `PATCH /api/v1/cat/items/{id}` takes exactly one of `isActiveFl: true` (reactivate) or `publishStateCode` (a CAT_PUBLISH_STATE code). Deactivation stays `DELETE`.
2. `POST /api/v1/cat/items` carries `bundleComponents` when `itemKindCode` is BUNDLE; `PUT /api/v1/cat/items/{id}/bundle-components` replaces the active lines of an existing Bundle.
3. The import is synchronous: a validation pass over every row with no write, then one transaction that creates the valid rows; a number-series failure rolls the whole import back (RULE-CAT-005).
4. The import sheet (xlsx) and the label document (PDF from the given `PrintApi`, report registered by `CatBarcodeLabelReportProvider` under code CAT_BARCODE_LABEL) are returned as binary bodies, not wrapped in `ApiResponse<T>`; their errors use the normal envelope.
5. Derived response properties, computed by the service at read and never stored: Variant `nameAr` / `nameEn`, `displayNameEn`, `effectiveEinvoiceCodeTypeCode`, `effectiveEinvoiceCode`, `einvoiceUnitCode`, `embeddedValue`, `componentVariantCode`, `itemNameAr`, `firstBarcodeValue`. The manifest lists them with DBF "— (derived)".
6. A RULE whose message is shown on success is a catalog row with the 2xx status of its endpoint; the envelope carries its code and messages next to the data.
7. Search sorting is the one the SRS fixes (Items by nameAr, Variants by Item nameAr then code, trees by sortOrder); no sort parameter is offered.

## Consequences
- The API document marks binary responses with their media types.
- The frontend reads success messages from the envelope; it never composes them.

## Traces
REQ-CAT-006 · REQ-CAT-113 · REQ-CAT-114 · REQ-CAT-056 · REQ-CAT-059 · REQ-CAT-036 · REQ-CAT-038 · REQ-CAT-039 · REQ-CAT-102 · REQ-CAT-029 · REQ-CAT-119 · REQ-CAT-097 · REQ-CAT-019 · REQ-CAT-021 · REQ-CAT-106

<<<END ADR>>>

<<<ADR: ADR-CAT-049.md>>>
# ADR-CAT-049 — Items screen: one Save that owns ordered calls; record commands outside the form

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P3.2 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-28

## Context
SRS SCR-REQ-CAT-001 (B3) lists one Save for the Item (create REQ-CAT-024 / update REQ-CAT-004) and separate actions for each child line: add / change / deactivate Item unit, add GTIN / generate internal / add scale barcode, deactivate barcode, generate Variants, deactivate Variant, save the Variant e-invoice override, save Bundle components, upload / update / remove image. The API document has one operation per child action, and each one commits its line on its own (API-CAT-006, 008 – 010, 012 – 020). The profile convention `screen_composition` allows one save per screen: an inline control that carries its own save, beside a screen Save, makes the user believe both were saved. The SRS does not say whether a child action submits on its own or with the Item.

## Decision
1. The Items screen is a route page (`/cat/items/new`, `/cat/items/:itemPk`). Its child collections (Variants, Item units, barcodes, Bundle components, images) sit inline in panes under the header, as the `page` container prescribes. One line is added or changed in a one-line drawer. Confirming the drawer returns the line to the page's form state and saves nothing.
2. Two pickers over unbounded sets open as second-level views, siblings of the page: the Variant generation picker (attribute values) and the Bundle component picker (Variants of active STANDARD Items). Each one returns its selection to the form state and saves nothing.
3. The page has ONE Save. It owns the calls below, sent in this order. Each call is sent only after the one before it succeeded, and a part is skipped when it is unchanged:
   1. create `API-CAT-001` (carries `bundleComponents`, an empty array for a STANDARD Item), or update `API-CAT-003`;
   2. replace the Bundle component set `API-CAT-017` (only on update of a BUNDLE Item, only when the set changed);
   3. pending deactivations: barcodes `API-CAT-016`, images `API-CAT-020`, Variants `API-CAT-009`, Item units `API-CAT-013`. These go first so that re-adding a unit (RULE-CAT-028 next action) and the limits (RULE-CAT-014, RULE-CAT-038) see the reduced set;
   4. Item unit adds `API-CAT-010` and flag changes `API-CAT-012`. They go before barcodes, because a barcode unit must be an active unit (RULE-CAT-031);
   5. Variant generation `API-CAT-006`;
   6. Variant e-invoice overrides `API-CAT-008`;
   7. barcode adds `API-CAT-014` and internal barcode requests `API-CAT-015`, on saved Variants only;
   8. image uploads `API-CAT-018`, then image changes `API-CAT-019`.
4. On the first rejected call the sequence stops. Calls that already succeeded stay committed, because each one is its own transaction on the server. The screen re-reads the Item (`API-CAT-002`) and keeps the unsent and rejected lines as pending, with the rejection shown inline on the line that failed. A new Item that failed after step 1 continues on its new route `/cat/items/:itemPk`. The next Save resumes from the remaining pending lines.
5. Record commands are not form saves: Deactivate / Reactivate / Publish / Unpublish (`API-CAT-004`, `API-CAT-005`). Each runs at once after a confirmation, and only while the form has no pending change. With pending changes, its button is disabled and shows the "save first" hint.
6. Barcodes can be added only to Variants that are already saved. A Variant created by a pending generation takes its barcodes after Save.

## Consequences
- Every child action of SRS B3 is still offered, with its RULEs. Only the moment of sending changes, so no REQ is affected.
- The plan (F2 `ITEM-SAVE`, F4 Composition and Saves) states this order. The implementer does not choose another one.
- The bilingual texts of the partial-save notice and the "save first" hint are UX copy fixed in the ui-ux-spec. They are not catalogue messages.

## Traces
REQ-CAT-004 · REQ-CAT-024 · REQ-CAT-049 · REQ-CAT-056 · REQ-CAT-057 · REQ-CAT-077 · REQ-CAT-083 · REQ-CAT-084 · REQ-CAT-105 · REQ-CAT-118 · SCR-CAT-001

<<<END ADR>>>

# ADR-CAT-050 — Display data served by the given: lookup values, capability flags, image files

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P3.2 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-28

## Context
CAT screens show three kinds of data that no operation of `api-spec-cat.yaml` serves:
- the values and labels of the CAT_* lookup keys, which are loaded at request time from the core lookup module (REQ-CAT-073, REQ-CAT-074, REQ-CAT-076; SRS A2 "Lookup values are loaded at runtime from `mdl`");
- the `variants` and `bundles` capability flags, which decide whether Variant and Bundle functions are shown (REQ-CAT-011, REQ-CAT-012, REQ-CAT-014, REQ-CAT-015; ADR-CAT-041);
- the image file behind `fileDocumentRef`, which the given `file` module keeps in public image storage (REQ-CAT-105, REQ-CAT-109; D-08).

CAT consumes no business module (`consumes: []`), so no XM edge exists or is needed. The screens still depend on a source outside CAT.

## Decision
1. Each of the three needs is a cross-module display dependency (UXD), minted by P3.2 and keyed to the screens that show it:
   - UXD-CAT-001: lookup values and labels (owner `erp-core:modules.mdl`);
   - UXD-CAT-002: capability flags (owner `erp-core:modules.cu` behind FeatureFlags; the frontend reads them from the platform's app configuration read `GET /api/public/app-config` [KB:raw-idea.md, technical base]);
   - UXD-CAT-003: image file rendering (owner `erp-core:modules.file`, public image storage).
2. The frontend reads them through the platform shell's clients for the given. It never reads them through a CAT operation, and it does not invent a CAT endpoint for them. Lookup hooks are of kind `lookup`, with one hook per key shared across screens and a long-lived cache. The flag read is of kind `init` and is refreshed on every screen entry and on window focus (REQ-CAT-012: a change applies from the next request).
3. When a flag cannot be read, the screen treats the flag-bound function as unavailable and shows RULE-CAT-009's text. This mirrors REQ-CAT-013 on the client side; the server stays authoritative.

## Consequences
- UXD-CAT-001 … 003 are recorded in the ui-ux-spec and the P3.2 registry, and they are cited by F-blocks. They share nothing with XM and do not appear in backend artifacts.
- The user's permission set (the `sec` module) is platform session context read by the route guards. It is not a UXD, because no field shows it.

## Traces
REQ-CAT-011 · REQ-CAT-012 · REQ-CAT-013 · REQ-CAT-014 · REQ-CAT-015 · REQ-CAT-073 · REQ-CAT-074 · REQ-CAT-076 · REQ-CAT-105 · REQ-CAT-109 · UXD-CAT-001 · UXD-CAT-002 · UXD-CAT-003

<<<END ADR>>>

# ADR-CAT-051 — API coverage of the CAT screens and binding notes

Status : ACCEPTED (non-breaking) · Stage : P3.2 · Module : CAT v2 · Date : 2026-10-28

## Context
The frontend plan binds the six CAT screens to `api-spec-cat.yaml` (51 operations). Some operations serve readers other than CAT screens. A few shapes also leave the screen something to derive.

## Decision
1. **Operations no CAT screen calls (2 of 51).** `API-CAT-011` (read Item unit) and `API-CAT-046` (storefront catalogue read) serve consuming modules (INV, PUR, SLS, SFR) through the contract (CON-CAT-009, CON-CAT-014). The Items screen reads Item units inside `API-CAT-002`. Both stay in the document. Their REQs (REQ-CAT-079, REQ-CAT-122, REQ-CAT-115) are covered by other operations or by SCR-CAT-001's traces.
2. **Operations a CAT screen calls on behalf of the platform.** `API-CAT-047` (catalogue search) is exported by the Items screen module as the catalogue's contribution to the shell's global search (ADR-CAT-043). A hit opens `/cat/items/:itemPk` (SCR-REQ-CAT-001 "from: global search result"). `API-CAT-043` (barcode and scale-label lookup) backs the Items search "Find by barcode" field (SCR-REQ-CAT-001 B5 lists the lookup). Point-of-sale scanning belongs to SLS.
3. **Cross-screen reads that stay inside one page permission.** The Bundle component picker searches Items (`API-CAT-038`, active STANDARD only) and reads the chosen Item's Variants (`API-CAT-002`), not `API-CAT-042`. `API-CAT-042` needs PERM_CAT_BARCODE_LABELS_VIEW, which an Items editor may lack. Component lines are labelled by reading the Variant (`API-CAT-007`).
4. **Reads that may be refused for a custom role.** When a screen's own read succeeds but an auxiliary read returns CAT-403-FORBIDDEN, the affordance that read feeds is hidden, and the screen stays usable:
   - the Category tree (`API-CAT-039`): the Category field and filter are hidden, and the Category column shows the code;
   - the attribute list (`API-CAT-041`): "Generate variants" is hidden;
   - the catalogue settings (`API-CAT-045`): the SCALE barcode type is not offered;
   - the seeded Variant read on Barcode labels (`API-CAT-007`): the seed is dropped.
5. **Derived on the client from data it already holds.**
   - RULE-CAT-037 (`CAT-422-LABEL-VARIANT-NO-BARCODE`) returns only the localized error. The Barcode labels screen marks the lines whose `firstBarcodeValue` (VariantSearchRow) is empty and links each one to its Item.
   - The Items list shows the Category label from the cached Category tree (`categoryFk` → `CategoryNode.nameAr`).
6. **Request fields never sent by the UI.**
   - `code` (create and updates of Item and Variant), `itemKindCode` / `baseUomCode` on Item update, and `conversionFactor` on Item unit update. These fields are read-only in the UI, and the server rejects them under RULE-CAT-004 / 022 / 007 / 028.
   - `bundleComponents` is required by `API-CAT-001`. The UI sends `[]` for a STANDARD Item.
7. **Stories with no navigation of their own.** US-CAT-002 (changes reach every channel) and US-CAT-003 (behaviour follows flags) have no screen of their own. Their flows ride on SCR-CAT-001 (Save re-reads the Item: REQ-CAT-010; flags read on entry: REQ-CAT-012). No navigation is invented for them.

## Consequences
- The operations coverage table of the frontend plan marks `API-CAT-011` and `API-CAT-046` with ✗ and cites this ADR. Every other operation has a screen action and a route.
- No REQ is left without an SCR or F-block.

## Traces
REQ-CAT-079 · REQ-CAT-086 · REQ-CAT-104 · REQ-CAT-115 · REQ-CAT-122 · REQ-CAT-125 · REQ-CAT-056 · API-CAT-011 · API-CAT-046 · API-CAT-047 · API-CAT-043 · API-CAT-042 · API-CAT-007

<<<END ADR>>>

# ADR-CAT-052 — P4 test plans: track split, package binding, host data and recorded plan gaps

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Module | CAT |
| Version | v2 |
| Stage | P4 — Test Plan (lane test-gen) |
| Status | ACCEPTED (non-breaking) |
| Date | 2026-10-28 |
| Raised by | claude:opus (test-gen lane) |
| Applies to | `analysis/modules/CAT/v2/P4/backend-test-plan-cat.md`, `analysis/modules/CAT/v2/P4/frontend-test-plan-cat.md` |

## Context

The P4 engine derives one `TC-*` per `AC-*` and has each TC name the one split unit it is acceptance for. For the CAT v2 inputs, five derivation points are not mechanical:
- which track (backend, frontend or both) carries the TC of an AC;
- which unit a TC names when the plan places the behaviour of its REQ outside the SUB that holds the exercised endpoint;
- how a TC creates a lookup value that is not seeded, when the key's owner (CAT) publishes no add-value call;
- how an AC is asserted when the API document does not expose the field its Then names;
- how the three `UXD-*` that the frontend plan cites are tested, given that their owner is the given erp-core and not a business module.

Questions are forbidden in this lane. Every point below is decided non-breaking, and the run continues.

## Decision

1. **Track split.** A backend TC is derived for every AC whose Then is observable at an `API-CAT-*` operation (124 of 129 ACs). A frontend TC is derived for every AC whose Then is observable on a screen and whose refusal text, when asserted, is bound by a `text:` row of the frontend plan (52 ACs). Five ACs are observable only on a screen, so they get a frontend TC only: AC-CAT-014, 015, 027, 075, 076. The permission AC (AC-CAT-129) gets a TC on both tracks (engine §3). Coverage is counted over the union of the two plans: 129 of 129 ACs.
2. **Package binding.**
   - Backend default: the `SVC-API-*` SUB that holds the first API the TC exercises (`SVC-API-CRUD`, `SVC-API-SEARCH` or `SVC-API-INT`).
   - Backend exception: when the AC's REQ appears in the `traces=` of another unit and that unit's text states the behaviour the AC asserts, the TC names that unit:
     - `CORE` for AC-CAT-008 and 009 (catalogue-change events, outbox), AC-CAT-011, 012 and 013 (capability flags), AC-CAT-030 (English display fallback), AC-CAT-033 and 034 (number series) and AC-CAT-078 (a deactivated lookup value is kept on a record);
     - `DATA-DOM-MASTER` for AC-CAT-051 (generation rules RULE-CAT-012/013/014/020, placed under ENT-CAT-002/005);
     - `DATA-DOM-LOOKUP` for AC-CAT-096 (an inactive layout stops decoding) and AC-CAT-124 (a deactivated Unit e-invoice code gives an empty e-invoice unit);
     - `SEC-BE` for AC-CAT-129 (empty result instead of 403).
   - Backend units that no TC names: `DOC`, `ALIGN-BE` and `INT-C`. `INT-C` carries no block, because the XM register is empty. `DOC` and `ALIGN-BE` implement no AC of their own; they are exercised indirectly by every TC.
   - Frontend: `F2-SCR-CAT-00n` when the TC asserts a read, a mutation or the routing of a server code; `F3-SCR-CAT-00n` when it asserts a client validator or form behaviour; `F4-SCR-CAT-00n` when it asserts a route, visibility, composition, a flow or a `UXD-*` field; `SEC-FE` for the permission TC.
   - Frontend units that no TC names: `F1-SCR-CAT-001 … 006` (generated types only, no observable behaviour) and `ALIGN-FE` (alignment self-check).
   - If the profile does not flag these phases `no_tests`, the C10.11 findings for them are expected, and this decision records them.
3. **Host data.** The lookups block names CAT as the owner of every `CAT_*` key, but its values are held in the given `erp-core:modules.mdl`, and `api-spec-cat.yaml` publishes no add-value operation. A TC that needs a value the section does not seed (CAT_BRAND values, CAT_UOM `BAG`, CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT `H87`) has a `Host data` line that creates the value through the given mdl lookup-value maintenance (`com.erp.mdl.crossmodule.MdlLookupApi`, add value to key). The executor binds that given call. No host value is moved into a CAT seed.
4. **Catalogue isolation.** Every TC runs in a tenant of its own. A TC that asserts a closed option set has an explicit precondition that its tenant's key holds only the values the TC names: AC-CAT-075 (CAT_BRAND), AC-CAT-076 (CAT_UOM, only the 8 seeded values). The host values that other TCs need (for example `BAG`, `BRAND_068`, `OLDBRAND`) therefore never share a catalogue with the TC that leaves them out. No two TCs demand opposite states of one value.
5. **Fields the API document does not expose.** The following are asserted as the plan binds them, and the gap is recorded for a later P3.1 delta. In each case the AC's observable outcome is still asserted.
   - AC-CAT-018 and AC-CAT-021 name a Variant's `updatedAt`. `VariantSummary` and `VariantDetail` expose no audit field. The TCs assert that the Variant's `version` is unchanged. QR-CAT-014 moves `VERSION` together with `UPDATED_AT` on every Variant update.
   - AC-CAT-007 names "the existing Item's code as the next action". AC-CAT-106 says "the 2 Variants are listed". `LocalizedError` binds only `code`, `messageAr` and `messageEn`, so the TCs assert the envelope. The executor asserts the next-action code and the listed Variants once the document binds a field for them. On the frontend, the plan derives both locally: the next action is a search by nameAr, and the lines are pre-flagged `no-barcode`. The frontend TCs assert that.
6. **Fault injection.** AC-CAT-009 (commit failure), AC-CAT-013 (flag read without value) and AC-CAT-036 (number series error) need a failure of a given seam. The TCs state it as a precondition on the given's seam: the outbox / persistence commit, `SettingsApi`, or `NumberSeriesApi` made to fail. They do not specify a tool (`profile.stack.testing` is agnostic).
7. **UXD integration.** UXD-CAT-001 (lookup values), UXD-CAT-002 (capability flags) and UXD-CAT-003 (image files) are foreign-owned fields that SCR-CAT-001 renders. Their owner is the given erp-core. The frontend plan's `INT-UXD` phase is populated with the two cases of engine §5 per UXD (rendered, and empty or owner failure), grouped under the owner `erp-core`. That is 6 TCs. The backend `INT-XM` phase is absent, because no `XM-*` exists.

## Consequences

- No AC, rule, message, endpoint or field is invented. Every TC cites its AC, its REQ and the API or SCR it exercises.
- The analyze report may list C10.11 findings for the units named in point 2. They are expected and recorded here.
- A later P3.1 delta that adds the next-action code and the listed Variants to the error envelope, or the audit fields to the Variant views, turns the assertions of point 5 into direct ones. That change is MODIFIED on the affected TCs, not a new sequence.

<<<END ADR>>>

# ADR-CAT-053 — P4 test plans: unbound refusal texts and unseeded AC lookup values

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Module | CAT |
| Version | v2 |
| Stage | P4 — Test Plan (lane test-gen), round 2 after `gov.py analyze` |
| Status | ACCEPTED (non-breaking) |
| Date | 2026-10-28 |
| Raised by | claude:opus (test-gen lane) |
| Applies to | `analysis/modules/CAT/v2/P4/backend-test-plan-cat.md`, `analysis/modules/CAT/v2/P4/frontend-test-plan-cat.md` |
| Relates to | ADR-CAT-052 (§1 track split, §3 host data) — not rewritten; this ADR narrows two of its points |

## Context

`gov.py analyze` refused round 1 of P4 on two contracts:

- **C10.7 (msg-bound).** Eight frontend TCs asserted the words of a refusal or notice whose code the frontend plan routes to a control without a `text: <source>` binding. In the plan these codes are routed as "shows RULE-CAT-0nn's text", "text RULE-CAT-0nn" or "with RULE-CAT-0nn message", not as a `text:` row:

  | Code | RULE | Plan row that routes it | Frontend TC |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | CAT-201-EXISTING-VARIANTS-KEPT | RULE-CAT-012 | F2 ITEM-SAVE step 5 | TC-CAT-130 |
  | CAT-404-BARCODE-NOT-FOUND | RULE-CAT-047 | F2 BARCODE-LOOKUP-QUERY | TC-CAT-143 |
  | CAT-422-SCALE-LABEL-UNREADABLE | RULE-CAT-035 | F2 BARCODE-LOOKUP-QUERY | TC-CAT-144 |
  | CAT-200-PRIMARY-IMAGE-REPLACED | RULE-CAT-039 | F2 ITEM-SAVE step 8 | TC-CAT-145 |
  | CAT-400-SEARCH-TERM-TOO-SHORT | RULE-CAT-046 | F2 CATALOGUE-SEARCH-QUERY | TC-CAT-150 |
  | CAT-409-CATEGORY-IN-USE | RULE-CAT-025 | F2 CATEGORY-DEACTIVATE | TC-CAT-157 |
  | CAT-200-IMPORT-ROW-REJECTED | RULE-CAT-045 | F2 IMPORT-SUBMIT | TC-CAT-165 |
  | CAT-200-VARIANTS-IN-USE | RULE-CAT-010 | F2 TURN-OFF-CHECK-QUERY | TC-CAT-171 |

- **C10.8 (tc-data).** Six TCs used the AC values CAT_UOM `BAG` (AC-CAT-122, 123, 124; TC-CAT-120, 121, 122, and a mention in TC-CAT-138) and CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT `H87` (AC-CAT-126; TC-CAT-063, 175). The lookups block lists both as `values` that the section does not seed. The engine requires a `Host data` line that creates such a value through the call the key's owner publishes, by verb and path. The key's owner is CAT, and `api-spec-cat.yaml` publishes no add-value operation. The given mdl maintenance that ADR-CAT-052 §3 named has no verb and path in any input, so it cannot be named without inventing an endpoint.

The P4 lane may not edit the frontend plan or the API document, and questions are forbidden. Both points are decided non-breaking, and the run continues.

## Decision

1. **Unbound refusal texts (a P3.2 plan gap).** The eight frontend TCs in the table no longer assert the words. Each one asserts:
   - that the code is routed to the control the plan names (notice, banner, inline hint, result row or check panel);
   - that the control displays the envelope's `messageAr` / `messageEn`, or `ImportRowRejection.messageAr` / `messageEn`, unchanged. For RULE-CAT-046 no request is sent, so the TC asserts only that the plan's hint is shown and that no request is made;
   - the rest of the AC's observable outcome, unchanged from round 1.

   The words of each of these rules are asserted, copied from the SRS in ar and en, by the backend TC on the same AC: TC-CAT-009 (RULE-CAT-012), 046 (047), 051 (035), 054 (039), 064 (046), 034 (025), 084 (045) and 010 (010). AC coverage is unchanged (129 / 129 over both plans). A later P3.2 delta that adds a `text: RULE-CAT-0nn message` binding to these eight rows lets the frontend TCs assert the words again. That change is MODIFIED on the affected TCs, not a new sequence.

2. **Unseeded AC lookup values.** No named add-value call exists for `BAG` or `H87`, so each case uses a seeded value that keeps the AC's Given true. No host value is moved into a CAT seed, and no endpoint is invented:
   - AC-CAT-126 ("PIECE already has an active e-invoice unit; a second one is refused"): the second unit is the seeded active CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT value `BX` in place of `H87` (TC-CAT-063, TC-CAT-175). The refusal comes from RULE-CAT-043 either way. A seeded value also keeps RULE-CAT-006 from refusing the request before the duplicate check.
   - AC-CAT-122, 123, 124 ("a unit of measure with no active Unit e-invoice code"): the unit is the seeded active CAT_UOM value `DOZEN`. TC-CAT-120 and 121 first deactivate its seeded code `DOZEN → DZN` (D-12) through API-CAT-037, so DOZEN has no active Unit e-invoice code, which is the Given of REQ-CAT-120. TC-CAT-122 uses the seeded `DOZEN → DZN` as "the active Unit e-invoice code" and an Item unit `DOZEN`. The AC's e-invoice values `EA` and `BX` are seeded and kept.
   - TC-CAT-138 drops its "e.g. BAG" mention. Its precondition (the tenant's CAT_UOM holds only the 8 seeded values) is unchanged.

   Each TC's `Host data` line now reads `none`, and its `Test data` line says which AC value was replaced and why. The other host values (`BRAND_068`, `OLDBRAND`, `BRAND1_137 … BRAND6_137`, absent `XYZ`) are unchanged. Every TC still runs in a tenant of its own (ADR-CAT-052 §4), and no value is demanded in opposite states.

## Consequences

- No AC, rule, message, endpoint or field is invented, and no TC id is renumbered. The TCs edited are TC-CAT-063, 120, 121, 122 (backend) and TC-CAT-130, 138, 143, 144, 145, 150, 157, 165, 171, 175 (frontend). All of them remain ADDED in this version.
- The frontend plan holds a recorded gap: eight routed codes without a `text:` binding (point 1). The executor implements the routing as the plan states it.
- The ACs that name `BAG` and `H87` are covered with seeded values. A later delta that publishes an add-value operation for CAT_UOM / CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT (or adds `BAG` / `H87` to `seeded`) lets these TCs use the AC values again. That change is MODIFIED on the affected TCs.
- The next free ADR is ADR-CAT-054.

<<<END ADR>>>

﻿# ADR-CAT-054 — Tenant reference is column-only

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Module | CAT |
| Version | v2 |
| Stage | P2 — Database (repair round 1) |
| Status | ACCEPTED (non-breaking) |
| Date | 2026-10-28 |
| Applies to | `analysis/modules/CAT/v2/P2/db-script-cat.md`, `registry-db-cat.md` |

## Context
`gov.py analyze` refused C6.15 (db-column-only) on 12 `FK_<TABLE>_TENANT` constraints referencing `CORE_TENANT`, a table of the given erp-core that this script does not create. A cross-module reference is column-only.

## Decision
`TENANT_ID` stays on every table, with its tenant-led index and tenant-composite UNIQUEs, but the 12 FK constraints are removed. Tenant validity is enforced by the given tenancy layer. No XM is minted: the tenant is a given, not a business-module edge (SRS A8 `consumes: []`).

## Consequences
Supersedes the FK part of D-P2-03. DBF ids, columns and counts are unchanged. Next free ADR is ADR-CAT-055.
